# klaviyo_account (Data Source)

Read-only metadata about a Klaviyo account. Defaults to the account associated with the provider's API key; specify `id` to fetch a different account when the key has multi-account access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    klaviyo = { source = "aroma-zone/klaviyo", version = "~> 0.1" }
  }
}
provider "klaviyo" {}

# No `id` set: returns the single account the API key is scoped to.
data "klaviyo_account" "current" {}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.klaviyo_account.current.id
}

output "account_currency" {
  value = data.klaviyo_account.current.preferred_currency
}

output "account_timezone" {
  value = data.klaviyo_account.current.timezone
}

output "account_public_key" {
  value       = data.klaviyo_account.current.public_api_key
  description = "Safe to expose to client-side code."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Klaviyo account ID. If unset, defaults to the single account the API key is scoped to.

### Read-Only

- `contact_information` (Attributes) CAN-SPAM contact information used in email footers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contact_information))
- `industry` (String) Industry classification.
- `locale` (String) Account locale (e.g. `en-US`).
- `preferred_currency` (String) Preferred currency code (e.g. `USD`).
- `public_api_key` (String) Public API key (safe to ship to clients).
- `test_account` (Boolean) True if this is a Klaviyo test account.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone.

<a id="nestedatt--contact_information"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contact_information`

Read-Only:

- `default_sender_email` (String)
- `default_sender_name` (String)
- `organization_name` (String)
- `website_url` (String)
